faq.question: What is in the landing page and what is not?
faq.answer: One page with a custom design, a lead form, analytics and basic SEO. Everything else is an option: online booking, payments, a quiz, a calculator, a blog, CRM. Option prices are on this page.

faq.question: How many days does a landing page take?
faq.answer: 14 days, and the deadline is written into the contract.

faq.question: How many revisions are included?
faq.answer: Two rounds of revisions. Extra revisions are billed at the hourly rate from the price list.

faq.question: Will AI search find the site?
faq.answer: Every plan includes schema.org, llms.txt, FAQ markup, OG and hreflang, so the site is ready for AI search. We do not promise a place in the results.

faq.question: How is the Business site different from a landing page?
faq.answer: Up to seven pages instead of one, an admin panel for your own edits, a blog, Russian and English versions, and a CRM integration.

faq.question: Can I edit the texts myself?
faq.answer: Yes, in the admin panel. In a one-hour training we show how to edit texts and check leads.

faq.question: What if I need more than seven pages?
faq.answer: Extra pages are estimated separately by scope. We name the amount before work starts.

faq.question: How long does the Business site take?
faq.answer: Three weeks, and the deadline is written into the contract. Two rounds of revisions are included.

faq.question: What does “Telegram and MAX for one price” mean?
faq.answer: One React codebase and two messenger adapters. The app runs in both Telegram and MAX, and the second platform adds nothing to the price.

faq.question: Which modules can I add?
faq.answer: Booking, loyalty, a showcase with ordering, and a referral program. We settle the set at the brief.

faq.question: Why is the price “from”?
faq.answer: Every project has its own modules and integrations. We name the exact amount after the brief.

faq.question: What does the plan include besides the app itself?
faq.answer: A bot and an admin panel. The 3–4 week deadline is written into the contract.

faq.question: Are payment and delivery included?

faq.question: What is an MVP in your plan?
faq.answer: A web app with authentication, user accounts, payments, integrations and analytics: the minimum you can use to test an idea with real users.

faq.question: Why does it take 6–10 weeks?
faq.answer: The range depends on the number of user accounts and integrations. We fix the exact deadline in the contract after the brief.

faq.question: Who owns the code?
faq.answer: The source code stays with you.

faq.question: What happens after launch?
faq.answer: A 30-day warranty. After that you can add support or a Dev subscription.

faq.question: What does support include?
faq.answer: Hosting administration, monitoring, backups, updates and hours of edits according to the plan.

faq.question: Where does the hosting stay?
faq.answer: On your account. The studio administers it, and the access stays with you.

faq.question: What if the hours of edits run out?
faq.answer: Extra work is billed at the hourly rate from the price list. If you need many edits, a Dev subscription is an option.

faq.question: How do I pay for support?
faq.answer: Monthly. The price on this page is the fee for one month.
